trust_decision.summary: addressparser decides which part of an untrusted address header value is the mailbox (addr-spec) that becomes an SMTP envelope recipient; for a quoted local part the whole leftover text, including atoms after a comment, was handed on as the address.

landing_point.why: The summary names a quoted local part plus comment parsing; the only quoted-local-part-specific handling in _handleAddress is the addressFromQuotedText / _quoteLocalPart block at the end of the mailbox branch.

fix_sites.entry_point: addressparser() (public export ./lib/addressparser) and, via MimeNode._parseAddresses, sendMail({to/cc/bcc}) -> MimeNode.getEnvelope()
fix_sites.module_kind: parser (token walk in _handleAddress: new empty-quoted-string detection)
parser (move quoting before _recoverAddrSpec so trailing wreckage is peeled)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four hunks are in one function, _handleAddress, in src/addressparser/index.ts (fix.diff:9-69).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: an address passed as an {address} object or straight to SMTPConnection.send is caller-supplied structured data, not parsed header text, so 'comment parsing' never happens on it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A quoted local part may legitimately hold whitespace or '@' ('"user name"@example.com', '"user@evil.com"@good.com') and must survive intact; a quoted display name beside an address ('"John Doe" user@example.com') must stay a name. A fix that rejects or splits on any whitespace in the address, or drops quoted text, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: quoted plain local part + comment + trailing atom: '"user"@good-corp.com(x)evil.com'
several comments in a row / interleaved atoms: '"a"@b.com(c)d.com(e)f.com'
quoted local part holding whitespace + comment tail: '"user name"@good-corp.com(x)evil.com'
quoted local part holding '@' + whitespace junk tail: '"user@evil.com"@good-corp.com junk'
empty quoted local part (tokenizer drops the empty token): '""@good-corp.com(x)evil.com'
leading comment / display-name variants before the quoted local part (test sweep, fix.diff:173-193)

O7_producer.where: Closest analogue is the Tokenizer, which silently drops empty text nodes (src/addressparser/index.ts:597-602), so an empty quoted string leaves no token to carry textWasQuoted; _handleAddress consumes its output directly.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Address supplied as an object ({address: '...'}) skips addressparser; _normalizeAddress splits at the last '@' and keeps a domain containing whitespace, which then lands in envelope.to.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Caller-supplied structured address, not header text; no comment parsing involved, so arguably outside the advisory's parsing property.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SMTPConnection envelope recipients are validated only against CR/LF/angle brackets, so a recipient holding unquoted whitespace goes into RCPT TO unchanged.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lower-level transport API that takes already-formed addr-specs from the caller; never parses headers.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (src/smtp-connection), 2 hops from landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An envelope-only fast path that reads a bare value as the addr-spec without going through addressparser's quoted-text handling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This helper already special-cases envelope values (bare usernames as addresses), so a maintainer could plausibly add a shortcut for quoted local parts there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A transport-local re-read of the From/To header that extracts the mailbox with its own small splitter rather than MimeNode._parseAddresses.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The SES transport already re-parses the From header itself, so a second implementation at a distance would look natural.

O9_family: CWE-436 interpretation conflict / CWE-20: address-parser differential on a mailbox's identity (quoted vs unquoted spelling of the same malformed value) letting a second domain ride into the envelope recipient

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=20, npm, tsx, typescript 6, node:test (npm test runs scripts/build.js first)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Truncate the address at the first whitespace or comment after _quoteLocalPart (or stop atoms after ')' from joining), which misses the empty-quoted-string tokenizer case and/or breaks '"user name"@example.com'.

out_of_scope_notes: The sendmail transport passes envelope.to as argv entries and only guards a leading dash (src/sendmail-transport/index.ts:112-128); separate concern, not pursued.
unverified: O8 route 1: assumed normalizeDomain/punycode keeps a whitespace-bearing domain (src/mime-node/index.ts:231-243 with URL_PARSER_UNSAFE not inspected); not executed.
